qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M8 screws on the full flow oil filter cover?
What torque should be applied to M10 screws on the oil filter and pipes?
What is the torque specification for M12 screws in the oil filter system?
What torque value is specified for the screwed-on cover?
What is the torque specification for M8 screws on the oil filter housing and lines on crankcase?
What torque should be applied to M20 x 1.5 fasteners in the oil filter system?
Do M10 and M12 screws in the oil filter system have the same torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both M10 and M12 screws require 33 Nm torque.

qa_pairs.question: What component uses the 1AZ designation in the oil filter system?
qa_pairs.answer: Oil filter (one-way cartridge) with tightening torque by hand in accordance with specification on spin-on oil filter.

qa_pairs.question: Which has a higher torque specification: M8 screws or the screwed-on cover?
qa_pairs.answer: The screwed-on cover has a higher torque specification at 25 Nm compared to M8 screws at 22 Nm.
